content: Hamamelis virginiana, commonly known as witch hazel, is available in products such as Tucks Medicated Pads and is used for specific indications. It is applied topically as needed (PRN) and is also available in the form of hamamelis water. This product is effective for relieving itching and irritation and may also be effective in reducing inflammation of the skin and mucous membranes. If ingested, the tannins present in witch hazel may lead to adverse effects such as nausea, vomiting, or potential liver damage. Hypersensitivity reactions may occur, and oral use is contraindicated. Regarding pregnancy, witch hazel is categorized as N/A, but it is generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. Information on its safety during lactation is also categorized as N/A.
